paper.title_verified_full: Iterative Screening of Vitamin E-Based Functional Lipid Nanoparticles for mRNA Delivery.
paper.title_source: Europe PMC REST core record, SRC:MED EXT_ID:40433897, fetched 2026-11-10
paper.original_research_discriminator: abstractText length 1199 (non-zero) AND the SI contains Methods-grade material (17 figures of measurements, HRMS characterisation, a 60-row orthogonal formulation table). Not a research-highlight commentary.
paper.endpoint: nucleic-acid delivery (mRNA FLuc luminescence, mRNA/pDNA GFP+ %, siLuc knockdown) - IN SCOPE

held.what: Supporting Information: Tables S1-S2, Figures S1-S17
held.note: Pre-supplied in source/ by the caller; watermarked 'Downloaded from pubs.acs.org/... by PHILLIPS EXETER ACADEMY user on 10 November 2026'.

not_held.why_not_acquired: Europe PMC: isOpenAccess=N, inEPMC=N, inPMC=N, fullTextUrlList has only the DOI with availability 'Subscription required'. NCBI elink dbfrom=pubmed&db=pmc returns ONLY linkname 'pubmed_pmc_refs' (7 citing PMCIDs) and NO 'pubmed_pmc' self-link, so no PMC deposit exists and there is no PMCID to fetch. Per PIPELINE_V2 BROWSER_ACQUISITION, ACS needs a browser; this run was explicitly forbidden from using the shared browser. No paywall or bot-check bypass was attempted.
not_held.consequence: Main-text Figures 1-6 (which hold the full iterative screen across the 35-amine library) are UNSEEN. Everything below is SI-only.

not_held.why_not_acquired: provenance/tools/find_repo.py --pmid 40433897 --title 'vitamin E lipid nanoparticle mRNA' --author Zhang returned no candidate above noise (top hits are unrelated pathology-lab and biology repos). No Zenodo/Dryad DOI is referenced anywhere in the SI text.

tier_availability.1_publisher_source_data: ABSENT. ACS Nano published exactly one supplementary asset for this DOI (nn5c01378_si_001.pdf); there is no Source Data workbook. Not verifiable further without the publisher landing page (browser forbidden) - recorded as UNVERIFIED-ABSENT, not as a checked absence.
tier_availability.2_si_numeric_table: PRESENT but carries NO endpoint. pdfplumber find_tables() recovers Table S1 (p2, flow-cytometry antibodies: dilutions/clones/catalogues) and Table S2 (p2-3, 60-row orthogonal formulation design: VN2C2 / DDAB / Chol / DMG-PEG mol%). Table S2 is FORMULATION METADATA, not a measurement. No SI table contains a delivery value.
tier_availability.4_pdf_text_vector: ABSENT for values. The only numerals in the SI text layer are Table S1/S2 cells, the 8 HRMS calc/found pairs in the Figure S2 caption, and figure-caption n's. No value appears as text.
tier_availability.4b_pdf_vector_geometry: IMPOSSIBLE, with a checkable reason: every figure on pages 4-11 is a single flattened DCTDecode JPEG. pymupdf get_drawings() returns exactly 2 paths on each of pages 4-11 and those 2 are the page-furniture rectangles of the ACS download watermark, not figure content (pages 1-3, which carry no figure at all, have 2, 7 and 3 paths respectively). There are 0 vector bond paths and 0 vector axis paths anywhere in the document.
tier_availability.5_pixels: The ONLY route to any value in this SI. Justified by the four lines above.

native_dpi.method: pymupdf get_images(full=True) + get_image_rects(): dpi = image_pixel_dimension / rect_dimension_in_points * 72. Measured on the EMBEDDED raster, not on a page render.
native_dpi.tolerance_rule: curation/lib tolerances are written for a 600 dpi render. Any px tolerance applied to these rasters must be scaled by 600/native_dpi (x2.73 at 220 dpi). Both the 600-dpi-equivalent figure and the native-px figure are recorded per panel in 07_qc.json, and the widened tolerance is seeded there to prove it still bites.

panels.what: four 3-D response surfaces, GFP+% over (VN2C2/DDAB) x (Chol/DMG-PEG) at DDAB = 20/40/60/80%
panels.why: A fitted response SURFACE, not individually measured formulations. Nothing on it is a reported measurement of a named LNP; it is the regression of the Table S2 design. Trap-1 case: 'plotted marginal/fitted means over factors' is a third number, distinct from formulations and from measured means.
